raw_definitions: Definisi : n 1. ( building ) gereja; 2. ( service ) sembahyang (di gereja): they were late for ~, mereka terlewat utk sembahyang di gereja; 3. ( often C~ ), ( institution ) Gereja: the Presbyterian C~, Gereja Presbyterian; the Roman Catholic C~, Gereja Katolik; /enter, go into/ the C~, menjadi paderi. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
